lore.tagline: Hold the line at Relay Core B-4. Three pushes. One Warden.
lore.briefing.speaker: HOLLOW ACCORD // RADIO
lore.briefing.text: B-4 is still warm. The perimeter is gone and Cinder cannot turn around. They come in three pushes now: the yard, the gantry line, then the node itself. Lantern will patch you between pushes. Take what the yard gives you. Count what you bring back. Accord out.
lore.briefing.assigned: WARDEN ASH-12, CALLSIGN FLINT. DIRECTIVE: HOLD B-4.
lore.threat.skitter: Low crawler. Weak alone, endless in numbers.
lore.threat.hollow_warden: An unrecovered Warden frame, still driven by CHORUS. Not Accord. Armored line-breaker.
lore.threat.rusher: Fast breach threat. Sprints straight for the core.
lore.threat.siege_hulk: Node 9. Takes three slots at the core and shoves the rest aside.
lore.results.victory: B-4 is still warm. Node 9 is not. The yards hold. Flint is still standing. Accord out.
lore.results.defeat: relay core b-4: offline. wardens active at b-4: 0. network preserved.
